content:
Seth Meyers on Thursday called out Democrats whose failure to show up for a vote helped derail an effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth.

“All Democrats had to do was show up and, on the heels of a historic victory, fueled in large part by anger over the Iran war, that should be pretty easy, right?” the “Late Night” host asked.

Meyers then cut to news footage of the failure of Rep. Thomas Massie’s (R-Ky.) push to impeach Hegseth, with 11 House Democrats missing the vote and some of those who did show up blasting their absent colleagues.

“Seriously, Democrats, what the hell? If you want to vote yes, vote yes. If you want to vote no, vote no,” said Meyers.

“But just missing a huge vote a week after Americans gave you a historic mandate is insane,” he added.
